notes.title: Alpha V3.0.7 released on the release channel
notes.notes:
2 of the biggest fixes in this interim update are the single player menu with added data and the player name bug in the scoreboard for single player. 

For full patch notes see list below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37717548/b490c44f4d0f9c91861cc2ee0ece72fb0fc17593.jpg[/img]

Release notes version 3.0.0 -> 3.0.7

Saranity developer initiated:

  - UI:
    - Added patch notes menu
    - Update Single player scoreboard emnu to reflect correct text.
    - Removed default player save state. This will prompt for playername on 
      game start if not set.
    - Updated host / Join menus to include Discord channel
    - Updated the Single player menu with info about the levels and enemies

  - Single Player:
    - Name and music did not load correct from stored profile. Now fix by 
      loading 
    - profile also for single player.

Community initiated:

  - Item drops:
    - Increased the gold bag drops with 40 % and added a light emitter ion top     
      for better visibility.

  - Wave Spawn:
    - Count down timer for first wave is removed. 

Special thanks for submitting ideas to:
- Devray16

notes.title: New map coming to the release of Saranity
notes.notes:
New  map coming to the release version of Saranity. The map features a all new city layout places in the forest when nightfall is setting in.

The map will be available in single player as level 3 and  in Coop multiplayer mode. Later on i might convert it also to a VS game mode map.
